name: LG Refrigerator Water Filter Replacement
shortDescription: Keeping your refrigerator in tip top shape with a brand-new water filter is a smart move. By changing your LT1000P / LT1000PC water filter on a regular basis, you'll continue to reduce contaminates such as iron, particulates and chlorine in your drinking water and ice cubes. You'll notice the difference!
metaDescription: LG Replacement Refrigerator Water Filter with filters chlorine taste and odor

features.text: Genuine LG refrigerator water filter replacements ensure perfect compatibility & filter reminders on every LT1000PC equipped refrigerator.
Keep your fridge water dispenser & ice tasting great by removing impurities fast.
Tested & certified to reduce chlorine, lead, mercury, benzene, asbestos, cysts, & more – delivering healthier, better-tasting water.
Delivers up to 200 gallons or 6 months of purified water before replacement is needed
No tools required – just twist out the old filter and lock in the new one for fast, easy, & clean setup in seconds.
Designed specifically for LG refrigerators; no guesswork, no third-party warnings – just secure, certified OEM parts.
*Please review the owner manual of your LG refrigerator to ensure proper filter purchase.
